subject: Invoice submission method and compact template proposal
body:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarsupply.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <acct-pay@stellarsupply.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on invoice delivery to Redwood

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the onboarding call this week. We are finalizing our AP flow and wanted to confirm Redwood's preferred invoice intake method and template. Two quick Qs:

1) Portal vs email — our ERP (Sage) can push PDFs automatically to an SFTP endpoint or we can send via SMTP/email. Do you require vendors to use the portal or is email still accepted?

2) Template — we have a standard PDF and can also export CSV with line items. Do you prefer a single-line summary CSV, or full line-item detail? If you have a compact sample, can you share it so we can validate mapping?

We need this to finalize our billing cutover on May 10.

Attached: stellarsupply_invoice_example.pdf (sample invoice)

Appreciate the guidance — Samantha
Accounts Payable Manager
Stellar Supply Co.

--------------------------------------------
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarsupply.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery to Redwood

Hi Samantha — great questions and thanks for the example. Short answers up front: portal preferred; compact CSV acceptable with a small set of required fields. Details below so your ERP team can map.

Portal vs email
- Preferred: use the vendor portal (link sent in onboarding packet). Portal gives faster ACKs and automatic PO matching.
- Email fallback: accepted during initial migration window (up to 30 days) but we treat these as exceptions and they require manual matching, which increases processing time. If you plan a one-time batch for the go-live, email is OK; for recurring billing please use portal.

Minimum fields for compact CSV (preferred for high-volume suppliers)
- vendor_name, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency (ISO), po_number (if applicable), remit_to_entity, line_count (optional), attachment_filename (if PDF provided)
- If you must include line items, we accept them as a separate CSV with invoice_number as the join key.

PO stamping / PO handling
- If PO is present, our ledger system requires PO stamping on the invoice. For vendors who cannot stamp PDFs, include po_number in the CSV and include the PO PDF as an attachment in the portal upload. Jordan — can you confirm the acceptable PO PDF naming convention?

Attachments / Filetypes
- Portal: CSV or PDF (single PDF per invoice recommended).
- Email fallback: attach PDF named like Redwood_PO{po_number}_INV{invoice_number}.pdf to help ops.

Samantha — I attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf that captures our portal credentials and the compact CSV sample (sample_invoices.csv) for your ERP team. If you can map the CSV fields to Sage export by next Tuesday (May 1) we can schedule a validation run before your May 10 cutover.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (form + portal instructions)
Attachment: sample_invoices.csv (compact template)

--------------------------------------------
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarsupply.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery to Redwood

Thanks — quick clarifications on PO stamping and the validation run:

- PO naming convention: Redwood_PO{PO_NUMBER}_VENDOR{VENDOR_SHORT}_INV{INVOICE_NUMBER}.pdf (example: Redwood_PO12345_VENDSTL_INV9876.pdf). Using this exact prefix helps our OCR and PO-matching workflow.
- Validation run: please export 5 recent invoices (both PO and non-PO) in the compact CSV format and attach the matching PDFs. We'll run them through our ingest pipeline in staging and report back within 48 hours.
- Edge case: multi-PO invoices — include a column po_numbers (semicolon-separated) and the portal will accept multi-PO lines; otherwise they will be split during processing and may delay payment.

Vanessa — can you add a check in the staging ingest to ensure currency and total_amount rounding rules (2 decimals) are enforced?

Jordan Blake
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

--------------------------------------------
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarsupply.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice delivery to Redwood

Hi team — thanks for the clear guidance. We can do portal for everything after go-live, and we'll run the 5-invoice validation export this Monday (May 1). A couple of notes from our ERP side:

- Sage export can be configured to include po_numbers as semicolon-separated; we'll map to that column.
- For PO stamping, our printer-based stamping is deprecated; we'll instead append the PO PDF to the portal upload and ensure files follow the naming convention you provided.
- We'll use the sample_invoices.csv you attached; I've included one of the real PDFs in this reply for reference (stellarsupply_invoice_example.pdf).

We'll aim to submit the validation package by EOD Monday. If you prefer a specific SFTP/portal test account for staging, point us to the Drive link or credentials and we'll push the files there.

Best,
Samantha Li
Accounts Payable Manager
Stellar Supply Co.

Attachment: stellarsupply_invoice_example.pdf (sample PDF from our ERP)
